title: A Gentle Boundary Check-In
excerpt: Boundaries are not about distance — they are about clarity. A short reflection to notice where you may feel emotionally overextended.
body:
Boundaries are not about distance. They are about clarity.

You may find it helpful to reflect:

- Where do I feel stretched or emotionally overextended?
- What am I saying “yes” to that feels misaligned?
- What would a softer, more honest “no” look like here?
- What feels emotionally safe for me right now?

Boundaries often begin as internal awareness before they become external action.
